name: Satake Kanoko
source:
“I’d like nothing more than for you to rely on me for everything...”

A Stars bearing the name of Sadalmelik.
Her ability as a Stars who hunts demons is outstanding despite still young and a second year.
She has a cool character and is not good at socializing. Her special skill is general household chores.
She happily takes care of Yuri, who is her senior and a teacher that she deeply respects.
In addition, she is also co-workers of the same organization as Maya and Petra.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361700/]Steam[/url]]
